feat: managed-walletd mode — exfer-mcp can spawn + supervise walletd (zero-setup)
In exfer-stack/exfer-mcp, his own repository.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-mcp/pull/2

Makes exfer-mcp self-contained like the browser MCP: when `WALLETD_URL` is **unset**, exfer-mcp spawns and supervises a `walletd` subprocess instead of requiring an externally-run one.

## Two ways to run
- **External** (unchanged): set `WALLETD_URL` (+ `WALLETD_AUTH_TOKEN`) → connect to a walletd you run. Still the default when set.
- **Managed** (new, zero-setup): leave `WALLETD_URL` unset, give only `WALLETD_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE` (+ `EXFER_WALLETD_BIN` if `exfer-walletd` isn't on PATH). exfer-mcp spawns walletd against the **default public mainnet node + indexer**.

## Defaults (so it "just works", all overridable)
- `EXFER_NODE_RPC` → public mainnet reference node + backup
- `EXFER_INDEXER_RPC` → public mainnet indexer (empty disables)
- `WALLETD_DATADIR` → `~/.exfer-walletd-mcp` (keystore + tokens persist)
- loopback bind with **free-port fallback** (never collides with a user-run walletd)

## Supervisor (`walletd_supervisor.py`)
First-run `init-seeded` (announces the recovery mnemonic to back up); spawns walletd; polls `get_block_height` until ready; reads the `token-spend` scoped token; **forwards logs with bearer tokens REDACTED**. Teardown on **every** exit path (atexit + SIGINT/SIGTERM + finally), SIGTERM→SIGKILL, idempotent, guarded against double-start — **no orphan walletd**.

## Verified
- Real spawn→health→teardown through the actual `server._resolve_config()` path: walletd spawned, `get_block_height` returned a real height, shutdown left **zero orphan daemons** (ps-confirmed).
- External mode intact (WALLETD_URL set → no spawn).
- Gates green: **pytest 45**, ruff check/format, mypy.

⚠️ The managed walletd is a **hot wallet**; the README documents the mnemonic-backup + hot-wallet warnings.
